szoveg_eredeti:
Thrive Holdings has agreed to acquire ADT in an all-cash take-private, valuing the home security company at $15.3 billion in enterprise value, the companies announced today.

The intrigue: The deal is being financed by funds managed by Apollo affiliates — ADT's former owner that sold its remaining stake just five months ago.

Follow the money: The $10 per-share deal values ADT at about $7.6 billion in equity value. It's a nearly 46% premium over ADT's closing price on Oct. 27.

Zoom in: ADT sells security systems, cameras and smart-home technology to residential and small-business customers, generating recurring revenue through monthly monitoring subscriptions.

Catch up quick: It's ADT's second take-private in a decade, after Apollo took it private in 2016 and brought it back to the NYSE in 2018.

What we're watching: There's a go-shop period through Nov. 28.
